SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , MAX(subq_17.repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(first_order_net_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN first_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_first_valid_orders" member_first_valid_orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', first_ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."valid_order_sequence" valid_order_sequence_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_17
answer: 在青禾当前客户范围、本周合成测试库（覆盖 2024-09-01 至 2026-09-01）下，2026 年 8 月统计结果：观测期首购会员数为 15 个 CRM 会员账户；观测期首单净销售额为 2,896.62 元；观测期首单数为 15 单；观测期后续购买订单数为 29,918 单。口径上，首购会员和首单均按全测试覆盖期历史先确定每个账户的首笔有效订单，再筛选落入 2026 年 8 月的部分，不代表终身首购；后续购买订单数指账户第二笔及以后的有效订单在窗口内计数，不是复购人数。金额由分换算为元展示。
question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的观测期首购会员数、观测期首单净销售额、观测期首单数和观测期后续购买订单数分别是多少？
